system.description:
Steppe and grassland under a wide sky. Nothing blocks the view, and a threat can be seen for miles. People travel far and fast, and meet trouble head on.

Talent: one Might die to d12, one Finesse die to d8.

  • Charge. When you move at least 30 feet in a line toward a target and use a Melee Technique against them in the same turn, the target takes -6 to Oppose rolls for 1 round.
  • Relentless Blow. You learn the Relentless Blow Technique: Melee, Stress, Pierce 4.
